map.会议时间冲突检测 使用指南: Meeting Time Conflict Detection User Guide
map.添加多个会议日程，自动检测同一日期/星期下时间段重叠的冲突，并标注冲突对，辅助排: Add multiple meeting schedules and automatically detect conflicts where time slots overlap on the same date/weekday, labelling the conflicting pairs to assist scheduling and coordination.
map.把一周内的会议安排（名称、日期、起止时间）录入，自动找出同一天时间区间重叠的会议: Enter the meetings for the week (name, date, start/end time) and the tool automatically finds meetings on the same day whose time intervals overlap, avoiding double-booking of the same meeting room or person.
map.跨部门协调周会时，先列出各方候选时段，用工具挑出互不冲突的组合，减少来回确认成本: When coordinating a cross-department weekly meeting, list each party's candidate slots first and use the tool to pick a non-conflicting combination, cutting back-and-forth confirmation.
map.排定培训或评审时，检测是否与已有的全员大会时间重叠，防止参会人分身乏术。: When scheduling training or a review, check whether it overlaps an existing all-hands meeting so attendees are not double-booked.
map.：录入：A 周一 09:00-10:30（周例会）、B 周一 10:00-11:: : enter A Monday 09:00-10:30 (weekly meeting), B Monday 10:00-11:00 (requirements review), C Tuesday 14:00-15:00 (customer call). The tool finds that A and B overlap between 10:00-10:30 (conflict) while C conflicts with nothing, and suggests moving B after 10:30.
map.同一日期下，若两场会议的 [开始, 结束) 时间区间存在交集即判为冲突（端点相接: For the same date, two meetings conflict when their [start, end) intervals intersect (touching endpoints such as one ending at 10:30 and another starting at 10:30 do not count). Meetings on different dates do not affect each other. The scheduling policy in force governs; the tool only does interval arithmetic.
map.支持跨天或周期性会议吗？: Are cross-day or recurring meetings supported?
map.当前按单条记录的日期与起止时间做两两比较，适合一次性或指定日期的会议。周期性（如: Currently it does pairwise comparison on the date and start/end times of individual records, suiting one-off or date-specific meetings. Recurring schedules (e.g. every Wednesday) can be entered week by week and checked separately; the tool does not expand a weekly calendar automatically.
